newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dai Nippon to supply parts to battery makers.
newsitem.headline: Dai Nippon to supply parts to battery makers.

text.p: Dai Nippon Printing Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it plans to start supplying electrode materials for lithium ion storage cells to battery makers in April 1997.

The company has developed new manufacturing technology with which the battery part can be made 10 times faster than the conventional method, a company spokesman said. The production cost was also cut by half, he said.
The firm expects sales in the first year to reach eight billion yen. Demand for lithium ion batteries has been growing rapidly amid a booming market for cellular phones and computers.
